evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Fuentes-Martínez et al., who defined the task, found that the one vision-language model they tested fell far behind specialised recognisers.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Remaining errors include Gothic F clefs read as C clefs, notes dropped with abbreviated or illegible text and lower accuracy on pages with small notation.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: The benchmark does not measure generalisation to unseen manuscripts: while the pitch error on AMNLT validation stays between 1.7 and 1.9 %, on 200 staves from five unseen manuscripts it falls from 24.9 to 1.3 % as we add chant aligned through CantusDB, Transkribus ground truth and silver staves kept only where two readers agree.
